description: Welcome to The Preserve in Tumwater! This 2020-built home pairs modern construction with a price that is hard to pass up. With 4 bedrooms, 2.75 baths and 2,394 square feet, there is room to spread out, work from home, and host with ease. One bedroom located downstairs near the full bath offers flexible living offering a private space for guests, multigenerational living, office space or a separate area for hobbies.    The seller has already installed new LVP flooring, giving the home a fresh, durable foundation. Bring your vision and choose the new carpet and backyard design that fit your style, whether that means a garden, a patio for summer evenings, or a spot for weekend gatherings. It is a rare chance to own a nearly new home and make it truly yours without paying a premium.    Just minutes from Kindred Park, you can enjoy paths, playgrounds, and open space close to home. Everyday errands, local restaurants, and easy freeway access are all within a convenient distance, making daily life simple.    Aggressively priced, this home offers great value in a well-established, popular community. Homes this new and this well priced tend to move quickly, so do not miss your chance. Sched
